aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:864.title: Contract Administrator - Pacific Northwest
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:864.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The Contract Administrator will work closely with legal, operations, accounting and production teams to review artist, venue, co-promotion, vendor, locations and sponsor agreements. Additionally, this position will work closely with Manager of Contract Administration and/or accounting team to process wire requests and deposits for artists and venues. The Contract Administrator will review venue insurance requirements per contract obligations and ensure needs are met on an event-by-event basis. Essential Functions Review and edit artist(s) contracts including issuing, mark-up, receipt and processing. Collect all pertinent information related to the agreement, clarify data points and issue to artist management team and talent buyers associated with deal. Review venue, vendor, co-promotion, sponsor and location agreements. Submit edited contract to supervisor, talent buyer, or general manager of venue for approval and issue to vendor, co-promoter, or sponsor. Initiate wire requests/deposits for artist and/or venue and submit for approval. Follow up with upper management for confirmation in timely manner to process with accounting department. Review venue insurance for potential risks or special circumstances. Amend insurance agreement to include additional information and coverage as needed. Develop and update contract process, create new ways to disseminate information from field to office. Ensure that all show files are up to date with new or revised contracts and insurance agreements. May be responsible for training new employees in contract administration and creating contract templates for training. May work with exhibitors ensuring paperwork is completed correctly and communicate venue information/updates as needed. Required Qualifications High School Diploma or its equivalency (BA/BS Degree Preferred) 2-4 years Of related work experience Paralegal, legal experience preferred Basic knowledge of contract administration and legal language Strong attention to detail and highly organized Ability to compare/analyze documentation Strong written and verbal communication skills Knowledge of Microsoft Office programs (Excel, Outlook, Word) and Adobe software Ability to prioritize, multi-task and perform well under pressure Interest/knowledge of music industry preferred Payscale: $23.75 - $30.00 p/h Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. improbable-improbable:ashbyhq:b90d0277-f.title: Product Marketing Manager, Prediction Markets
improbable-improbable:ashbyhq:b90d0277-f.description: At Improbable, we build and scale ambitious AI and Web3 ventures shaping the next generation of the internet. We’re hiring for a venture building a next-generation blockchain for real-time, large-scale applications, designed to overcome the speed and cost limitations of traditional blockchain infrastructure. The technology is fast, cost-efficient and fully EVM-compatible, enabling developers, creators and communities to build immersive products with greater ownership and interoperability. About the role We’re hiring a Web3 Product Marketing Manager to shape how a prediction protocol built for real-time markets shows up in the world. You’ll sit at the centre of product, growth, comms and community, turning a technically ambitious product into a story that traders, builders and partners can quickly understand. This is a hands-on role for someone who likes building from scratch. You’ll own the narrative, lead launches, and run the experiments that help turn a prediction protocol into a category-defining product. The team is small, decisions are fast, and the work gets into market quickly. What you’ll be doing - You’ll shape the positioning, launches and growth activity that help a prediction protocol stand out and gain traction. - Own the positioning and messaging for the prediction protocol end to end, including what it is, who it’s for, why it matters and what makes it different - Turn complex product strengths into clear, credible narratives for traders, builders and partners - Lead go-to-market for major launches, product milestones, partner activations and incentive-led moments - Define and run the marketing roadmap in partnership with product and community leads, making sure launches, campaigns and content build on each other - Grow the audience through always-on programmes that expand the qualified builder base - Run customer and market research with traders, builders and KOLs, and feed those insights back into product, pricing and creative - Brief and create content that earns attention in Web3, from launch threads and research-led content to explainer assets, dashboards, KOL kits and conference materials - Partner with comms on press, podcasts and thought leadership that reach the audiences that matter most What we’re looking for - Strong experience in product marketing or a closely related role, including hands-on prediction markets/protocol experience - Strong understanding of crypto products and onchain user experience, with enough fluency to market credibly to Web3-native audiences - A track record of owning launches end to end, from initial positioning through to measurable post-launch impact - Strong narrative instincts and the ability to turn complex product detail into clear, compelling messaging - Confidence working with data and using performance insights to shape campaigns and priorities - A hands-on, operator mindset with a bias towards shipping and a high tolerance for ambiguity Apply if you want to help shape how a new prediction protocol is positioned, launched and adopted. Improbable Candidate Privacy Policy https://www.improbable.io/candidate-privacy-policy

jobgether-jobgether:lever:05b9b52b-03d9-.title: Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:05b9b52b-03d9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist based in Israel. This is a senior creative role focused on shaping intuitive, expressive, and highly engaging interfaces for mobile games enjoyed by players around the world. You will define the visual identity of the game UI while building scalable systems that keep experiences consistent across devices and screen sizes. The role combines visual design, UX thinking, prototyping, design systems, and close collaboration with game development teams. You will transform concepts into polished interfaces, seamlessly blending 2D UI with 3D game assets while maintaining strong hierarchy and visual impact. You will also contribute to modern AI-assisted workflows that accelerate ideation, exploration, and asset creation. Success requires both artistic excellence and a systems mindset, with a strong understanding of mobile gaming conventions and player behavior. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast-moving, remote-friendly environment where creativity, experimentation, and collaboration are highly valued. Define and own the visual direction, layout, interaction patterns, and overall artistic quality of mobile game interfaces. Create high-fidelity 2D UI assets, icons, screens, menus, and interactive elements that are colorful, polished, intuitive, and optimized for mobile devices. Integrate 2D UI layers with 3D game assets while maintaining visual hierarchy, depth, readability, and a cohesive aesthetic. Build, scale, and maintain a component-driven UI design system in Figma, including reusable components, variants, variables, auto-layout structures, and responsive behaviors. Design modular and reusable UI components that account for mobile platform constraints and different screen sizes and aspect ratios. Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and iconography that prioritize intuitive navigation, touch ergonomics, and engaging player interactions. Design interfaces for modern free-to-play meta systems, including progression tracks, Battle Passes, collection systems, rewards, and other engagement features. Collaborate closely with programmers, technical artists, producers, and other creative stakeholders to ensure designs are implemented accurately and retain their intended visual quality in-engine. Use generative AI and AI-assisted design tools to accelerate brainstorming, mood-board development, concept exploration, iteration, and asset generation. Maintain clear design documentation and communicate UI logic and design-system principles effectively to technical and creative teams. Contribute to UI animations, visual effects, and other implementation considerations where appropriate. Continuously refine the player experience by balancing visual excitement with clarity, usability, consistency, and performance. Requirements 10+ years of professional game-art experience, including at least 5 years specializing in UI/UX art. A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile game UI/UX work, including visual case studies or references from at least 2 shipped mobile titles. Excellent understanding of composition, color theory, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and stylized 2D game-art production. Deep knowledge of mobile game UI principles, including touch interfaces, gesture controls, ergonomics, and iOS/Android design considerations. Strong understanding of free-to-play game meta systems such as Battle Passes, progression tracks, collection systems, and reward loops. Expert-level proficiency with Figma, including auto-layout, nested components, variables, variants, design systems, and interactive prototyping. Strong proficiency with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for high-fidelity asset creation, iconography, vectors, textures, and visual treatments. Proven experience creating and managing comprehensive UI design systems and style

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2ea895d8-71b4-.title: Data Analyst - MARVEL Strike Force
jobgether-jobgether:lever:2ea895d8-71b4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Analyst – MARVEL Strike Force based in Canada. This is a remote opportunity to turn player and product data into insights that shape the future of a live-service mobile game. You’ll work closely with product, design, economy, live operations, marketing, and leadership teams to understand player behavior and business performance. The role combines hands-on SQL and Python analysis with reporting, experimentation, tracking, and strategic storytelling. You’ll help identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention, monetization, progression, and overall game health. Working in a fast-moving environment, you’ll balance analytical rigor with the need to make timely, practical recommendations. You’ll also have the opportunity to thoughtfully incorporate AI-enabled tools into modern analytics workflows while maintaining strong standards for data quality, privacy, and accuracy. Use AI-enabled tools responsibly to accelerate data exploration, SQL/Python development, documentation, quality assurance, summarization, and insight generation while validating outputs and maintaining sound analytical judgment. Partner with product, design, economy, live operations, marketing, and leadership teams to translate data into actionable recommendations that improve player engagement, retention, monetization, and long-term game health. Own recurring business-health reporting, delivering KPI analyses, trend context, variance explanations, and clear executive-ready narratives explaining what changed, why it changed, and recommended next steps. Analyze player behavior across onboarding, progression, live events, offers, combat modes, and other core game systems to identify risks, opportunities, and sources of player friction. Design and validate analytics tracking for new features, live events, player offers, and experiments to ensure accurate measurement from launch onward. Support experimentation and A/B testing by helping define appropriate metrics, evaluate statistical significance, monitor guardrail metrics, and interpret post-test results. Communicate complex analytical findings through concise, compelling data stories tailored to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Work effectively in a live-service environment where priorities can shift quickly, data may be imperfect, and decisions require a combination of speed, rigor, and business judgment. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or another quantitative discipline; an advanced degree is an asset. At least 2 years of experience in data analytics, product analytics, business analytics, financial analysis, data science, or a comparable quantitative role. At least 2 years of hands-on experience using SQL and Python , including writing complex queries across multiple data sources. At least 2 years of experience creating reports and dashboards with Tableau, Looker, or a comparable business intelligence platform . Practical understanding of experimentation and A/B testing, including test design, metric selection, statistical significance, guardrail metrics, and post-test interpretation. Strong analytical thinking and the ability to distinguish meaningful patterns from incomplete, noisy, or imperfect data. Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to transform detailed analysis into clear and actionable recommendations. Curiosity and practical interest in AI-enabled analytics tools, combined with the judgment to validate outputs, protect sensitive information, and avoid unsupported conclusions. Comfortable collaborating across multiple functions and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
